name: never-twice
description: Never fix the same failure class twice: climb every correction to the most durable response reachable - architecture and data structures first, then CI checks, then rules.

interface.shortDescription: No failure class ever gets fixed twice by hand.
interface.longDescription: Fires when an agent is corrected or the same failure class is fixed twice, then climbs a four-rung ladder to the most durable response reachable: architecture or data structures so the class cannot recur, a CI lint or test so it cannot land, a skill or rule so the next agent knows, and human vigilance only as a last resort.
defaultPrompt: This is the second time we fixed this kind of bug - never twice.
I just corrected you on this again; climb the ladder instead.
Would a new member of this failure class be impossible to build, loud but late, or silent?
